title: Studio Stills client token file (tokens/clients/<id>.json)
description: One file per client. Leaves under color/font use W3C Design Tokens (DTCG): { "$type": "color", "$value": "#RRGGBB" }. Merge order for the style library: library/<style>/style.json palette <- color <- byStyle[<style>].color. Merge order for the legacy families: tokens/group-N.json <- color/font <- byGroup["N"]. Compliance values come only from the brokerage's licence record; empty or bracketed values ([BROKERAGE NAME]) render as visible placeholders and make --strict refuse.

id.description: Same as the file name and the roster key

name.description: Display name (never printed as a logo or signature)

initials.description: Logo mark in the legacy families

city.description: Used for datelines and the roster same-city rule

seed.description: Seeds hand-drawn marks and textures, so two clients never get identical strokes

font.description: Optional font overrides (legacy families), DTCG fontFamily leaves

brokerage.description: Brokerage's authorized name (Ontario: O. Reg. 188/08 s.6)

licence.description: Brokerage licence number without the leading #; the renderer prints LIC. #<value>

photos.description: Slot name -> file name inside assets/clients/<id>/ (the client's own photo; never stock or AI). Styles that use photos: magazine, annotated (cover slots). Use photos with a short side of at least 600 px.

byGroup.description: Per-family overrides for the legacy group families, keyed "1".."4"
